why_ai: Technologists position, inject and scan patients on site under licence, and radiologists sign every report, though referrers pick centres on convenience and network rather than relationship.
why_clarity: Each exam follows a written protocol and ends in an image and a signed report, repeated thousands of times, but whether the study answered the question shows up only later.
why_digital: The patient's body is scanned in a local building chosen by referral and network, while images and reports are digital and reading is remote.

why_ai: Booking, slot setting and gap filling are prediction and optimisation tasks that scheduling software and voice agents absorb.
why_clarity: Every slot is either filled with a completed exam or not, daily, so results are measured immediately against bookings.
why_digital: Orders and schedules are digital, though patients still phone and the exam happens in person.

why_ai: A licensed radiologist must interpret and sign each study and carries the malpractice exposure, and demand grows faster than supply.
why_clarity: Reports follow standard formats on near-identical studies, but readers differ in style and errors surface slowly through addenda and later outcomes.
why_digital: Reading is fully remote on screen, limited only by state licensure and facility credentialing.

why_ai: Licensed radiologists still sign every read and centres keep buying coverage, though which firm reads is largely interchangeable.
why_clarity: Turnaround is measured per study and contracts repeat the same service at volume, while read accuracy is checked only by sampled peer review.
why_digital: Images and reports move over networks and reading firms sell nationally, constrained by state licences.

why_ai: Drafting, worklist and prior-retrieval software is exactly what AI-native competitors and foundation models now build directly.
why_clarity: Time per study is measured instantly, but quality effects show up only in addenda and discrepancy reviews weeks later.
why_digital: Pure software on screen, sold remotely to radiology groups.

why_ai: Extracting faxed orders and matching approvals to exams are rule lookups that document AI and payer APIs are absorbing.
why_clarity: Each exam either matches its authorization or denies, at high volume, with denials revealing errors within weeks.
why_digital: Orders often start as faxes, but intake work is done on screen and is commonly centralised or outsourced.

why_ai: Technologists position women hands-on and MQSA-qualified physicians must interpret and sign, under federal inspection, with trust in the screening centre mattering to patients.
why_clarity: BI-RADS categories and MQSA rules codify the pathway and it repeats at screening volume, though cancers missed or found show up months later.
why_digital: Mammography is performed on the patient in a local centre; reports and letters are digital but tracking still runs on mail and phone.

why_ai: Trailers are driven, parked, powered and staffed on site in rural towns, a physical service that rural access will keep in demand.
why_clarity: Unit-days, set-ups and scans follow standard routines and are counted daily, though host demand varies week to week.
why_digital: The scanner and staff travel physically to each host, booked through local hospital contracts.

why_ai: Technologists screen, position, inject and care for patients in person under state and ARRT credentials, and they are the scarcest labour in the industry.
why_clarity: Protocols and safety checklists define the work and each exam's image quality is visible at the console.
why_digital: The work is on patients' bodies in the scan room; only the images leave digitally.

why_ai: The radiologist is accountable for the protocol and contrast decision, but routine orders are the kind of text classification models handle.
why_clarity: Protocols recur on thousands of similar orders, but experts disagree on the right one and adequacy shows up only after the scan.
why_digital: Orders and protocol libraries are digital and protocolling is done remotely on screen.

why_ai: Extracting recommendations from report text and running outreach are tasks NLP and care-gap engines already perform.
why_clarity: Each recommendation has a stated interval and is either completed on time or not, across thousands of reports.
why_digital: Report text in and outreach out by digital channels, with some phone and letter contact.

why_ai: Regulatory submissions depend on accountable, validated central reads and imaging science that sponsors keep paying specialists for.
why_clarity: Imaging charters and read paradigms codify the work and it recurs across trials, though endpoint validity is judged at submission.
why_digital: Images arrive digitally from sites worldwide and endpoint datasets are delivered electronically to sponsors.

why_ai: A specialty society's governance gives the benchmarks their credibility, and MIPS reporting sustains demand.
why_clarity: Data definitions and benchmark reports are standardised and recur, though quality outcomes are judged slowly.
why_digital: Facility data arrive electronically and benchmark reports are delivered online to participants.

why_ai: Radiologist second reviews and statistical grading carry clinical accountability, and plans trust a few established raters.
why_clarity: Error-rate methods are documented but contested, and whether steering improved outcomes is known only slowly.
why_digital: Sampled studies and claims arrive digitally and ratings are delivered online to plans and employers.

why_ai: De-identification and cohort curation are increasingly automated, though AI developers keep paying for licensed access to real images.
why_clarity: Curation follows defined de-identification and selection steps on similar studies, checked by buyers' validation.
why_digital: De-identified images in and licensed cohorts out, entirely online.

why_ai: Internal routing and quality analytics are screen work AI accelerates, though the firm's own AI products need clinical accountability.
why_clarity: Turnaround and discrepancy metrics recur daily, but analytics questions vary and model quality is judged over time.
why_digital: Read data in and internal dashboards and products out, inside one firm.

why_ai: FDA clearance and clinician-adjudicated ground truth protect them, but they compete with foundation models and other AI vendors.
why_clarity: Detection and drafting accuracy is measurable against labelled studies at volume, though clinical impact takes longer.
why_digital: Images and reports in, models delivered as software to customers anywhere.

why_ai: Expert panels' evidence judgements carry the ACR's authority, but with the AUC mandate rescinded fewer buyers must pay for them.
why_clarity: Panels follow a documented rating method, but each topic is a fresh evidence review and whether criteria improve care is rarely measured.
why_digital: Literature in and published criteria and licensed decision-support content out, all online.

why_ai: Failure prediction from machine logs is analytics AI handles, though service still ends with an engineer on site and OEMs control the data.
why_clarity: Component failures recur across fleets and predictions are checked quickly against actual failures.
why_digital: Machine logs stream in digitally, but the payoff is physical service and buyers are tied to their scanner's maker.

why_ai: Acquisition and site strategy are consequential, ambiguous calls that operators' boards will not hand to software.
why_clarity: Analyses vary by question and their effects show up slowly in operating results.
why_digital: Work is on screen inside the operator, serving internal clients rather than an open market.

why_ai: Claims analysis is screen work AI accelerates; the sponsoring society's brand carries the credibility.
why_clarity: Studies follow standard health-services methods, but projections are validated only years later.
why_digital: Claims data in, papers and policy briefs published online.

why_ai: Qualified medical physicists must test equipment in person and sign surveys that MQSA and accreditation require.
why_clarity: Survey procedures are codified and repeat on each unit annually, with pass or fail results.
why_digital: Testing happens on equipment in the centre, with reports delivered digitally to local clients.

why_ai: Statutory inspection authority and on-site inspections cannot be delegated to software.
why_clarity: Inspection checklists are set in regulation and repeat at every facility each year.
why_digital: Inspectors visit facilities in person and the agency is a state or federal monopoly.

why_ai: Survey tabulation is routine screen work; the association's membership carries the credibility.
why_clarity: Member surveys repeat on fixed instruments, but their usefulness is judged slowly by members.
why_digital: Survey data in, benchmark reports published online to members.
